name: Iceline Trail
why: Across a bench of bare rock and glacial lakes right under the Emerald Glacier, facing Takakkaw Falls, and down through the Little Yoho Valley.
book: No permit for the day. Yoho Valley Road (tight switchbacks, no trailers) opens late June to mid-October.
water: Streams and tarns on the bench; filter.
dangers: Snow on the high bench until mid-July.
Exposed to storms and wind above the trees.
Grizzly bears in the Little Yoho Valley.
